_doc: Spring bones for engine/src/systems/cloth.js. Bones come from engine/tools/hero_rig.py; tails are read from each chain's *_end child. hz = spring frequency of the first link (x taper per link down the chain), damp = damping ratio, sag = gravity share, inertia = reaction to the acceleration of the link's body-carried rest tip (turns, strikes, stride, stops), drag = trail against head velocity (cloak lifts in falls, streams in runs). Radii in m. windRad = swing (rad) per m/s of relative air, per link (cloak 0.055: ~0.36 rad per link at the 6.5 m/s run, so the hem streams at ~45 deg instead of lying flat, AIR_MAX 0.7 caps the 7.5 m/s l2 crosswind) (level wind + breeze x wind - own velocity); with windRad set, drag is normally 0 (the air term already trails the run).
